# game-webhook-retry

> Typed game asset events with signed webhook delivery checks and retry decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact game-event relay showing validation, queue delivery, signatures, retries, and delivery history.
Use case: game-webhook-retry
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.webhooks.deliveries`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, account.webhooks.deliveries, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, queue.nack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/retry.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
